subject: general
question: How many times has The Factory Act been amended as on June 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is " **8 **".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The factory act was for **improving the conditions of the children working in the factories**.
 
• The factory act was applied in **1948**.
 
• The factory act has been amended 8 times:- **1949, 1950, 1951, 1954, 1970, 1976, 1987 and 2022.**
